units: <cite ref="Chullin 57b:10">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ בדברים היה וכ׳</he> he used to make experiments, and he made one to disprove R. Judah’s theory.

<cite ref="Chullin 57b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>מאי ע׳ בדברים</he> why was he called an experimenter? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:1">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>ר׳ אסי הוה ע׳</he> R. A. used to experiment.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>ר״ש הוה ע׳ בדברים</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite> <cite ref="P00310"><he>עוֹסְקָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26b:7">Succ. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ידים ע׳ הן</he> hands are busy, i.e. touch things automatically.
